summary_en: Janome Corporation authorized repurchase of up to 1.0 million shares (5.98% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥1.0 billion through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 9, 2026 to November 8, 2027 to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Announcement of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, Janome Corporation's board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to 1.0 million shares of common stock, representing 5.98% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum expenditure of ¥1.0 billion. The repurchases will be conducted through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the one-year period from November 9, 2026 to November 8, 2027.

The company cited its mid-term management plan "Move! 2027" as the basis for the decision, under which it aims to strengthen shareholder returns in line with medium- to long-term profit growth. The board determined that treasury stock acquisition would enhance both shareholder returns and capital efficiency in pursuit of this objective. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 256,124 treasury shares against 16,723,081 outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.
